calls.reason: The mid-2027 window hasn't arrived and 'I'd be shocked' is hedged. Oracle's Sept 2026 call reports 6 of 8 buildings delivered, which leaves early full completion possible but unproven.

Oracle's Sept 2026 call reports 6 of 8 Abilene buildings (75% of capacity) delivered, and its Oct 2026 investor day calls the site close to fully executed. Both undercut the bet that it never gets built.
